title: THE FREE-DUST ENVELOPE DERIVATION ATTEMPT -- can the profile shape be derived?

references.G098: the REQUIRED dust profile rho_dust,req = rho_tot - A/r^2 - rho_b, floor A, committed arrays (per_cluster.canonical), 140-pt grid 0.1-1.25 R500; f_dust 0.75-0.86 inner -> 0.2-0.5 at R500; crossings 737-1059 kpc on 4/12
references.G108: the outer-window (r_M, R500) decomposition: pooled envelope slope -2.377 +- 0.152 (258 positive bins, rms 0.38 dex); 34/292 negative-dust bins
references.G103: the free dust is collisionless FOREVER at cluster scale: t_relax 70-76 orders above Hubble; static field-pinned boundary (the PHANTOM's, not the dust's)
references.G079: Omega_dm = 0.264, Omega_eq,capped = 0.00209 -> Omega_dust = 0.262 (99.2% of Omega_dm); the free dust IS the cosmic dark sector
references.G115: the free-dust particle: m > 3.3-5.7 keV, lambda_fs = 0.5-0.82 Mpc (WDM-class warm relic); the halo function cuts below ~1e6 Msun

classes.a: collisionless infall rho ~ r^-3/2 (spherical accretion onto a point mass, Bertschinger 1985; FG-early regime)
classes.b: phase-mixed halo rho ~ r^-2 (caustic-mixed infall; the flattest stable radial-orbit profile)
classes.c: NFW-class rho ~ r^-1..r^-3 (cosmological secondary infall, Fillmore-Goldreich 1984; marginal-EdS asymptote rho ~ r^-9/4, Gott 1975; Anninos+96 found r^-9/4 on CDM cluster scales)

V1.statement: NFW/FG-class secondary infall: the local slope in (-3,-1), the NFW 2-parameter form the lowest-scatter closed form, the r^-3/2 and r^-2 fixed classes excluded at >= 2-3 sigma pooled; outer-window -2.38 within 1 sigma of r^-9/4

V2.statement: the infall closes the required abundance under the frameworks' own composition reading (the infalling dark matter IS the infalling dust); the z=0 ambient density alone fails by 2-3 orders; assembly-equivalent z ~ 8.7 (ambient) / 4.5 (5.55 contrast)

V3.statement: THE FREE-DUST ENVELOPE IS A DERIVED ACCRETION-FLOW PROFILE IN CLASS, AN EMPIRICAL SHAPE IN NORMALIZATION.  (1) SHAPE: the REQUIRED rho_dust,req(r) (G098's inversion, floor A) on the resolved positive-dust window is NFW/FG-class: pooled slope -2.218 +- 0.021 over 1575 points (per-cluster median -2.19, range [-2.82, -1.74]), class rms a/b/c = 0.348/0.274/0.253 dex with the NFW 2-parameter form the lowest-scatter closed form (0/1/11 per-cluster winners); the fixed r^-3/2 (Bertschinger-class point-mass stream) and r^-2 (caustic-mixed) classes are excluded at >= 33.6 and 10.2 sigma pooled, and the committed outer-window slope -2.377 +- 0.152 (G108) sits 0.8 sigma from the collisionless secondary-infall asymptote r^-9/4 (Fillmore-Goldreich/Gott; Anninos+96).  THE DERIVATION does not yet close: the per-cluster scatter is 0.20 dex (median), the subtraction is unresolvable/negative in the outer bins of the same clusters where it counts (34/292, G108 V2 FAIL), and the phantom amplitude A = sqrt(G M_b(R500) a0)/(4 pi G) is the pinned input, not a fitted output -- the per-cluster NORMALIZATION is the last un-derived number.  (2) RESERVOIR: the infall closes the abundance: the cosmic-composition collapse reservoir holds 2.01 x the requirement at the point-mass floor and 6.24 x with the mass profile continued to R_ta at the outer slope -2.38 (M(<R_ta) ~ 3 x M500); the naive single-power-law stream under-fills R500 (0.23 of the requirement vs 0.50 needed -- V2d FAIL: the interior concentration is the mixed/caustic piece, not the naive stream), while the continued envelope delivers 2.01 x inside R500 (V2e); the z=0 AMBIENT density alone fails by 917x, so the envelope is accreted (expansion-equivalent z ~ 8.7, or ~4.5 with the turnaround contrast), not the ambient haze.  (3) CONSEQUENCE: the envelope is a STREAMING, growing structure (radial-biased orbits, beta(r) -> +1 outward; ~8.3e+12 Msun/Gyr capture today, ~8e3 Msun/yr; turnaround caustic at ~6-7 R500, unobserved) -- the free dust is NOT distributed (G103's collisionless timescale), and its registered outer-profile slope is the discriminant that already chose the secondary-infall class over the point-mass stream at 5.8 sigma.  THE HONEST STATE OF THE LAST CLUSTER PIECE: the envelope's SHAPE is derived to CLASS (NFW/FG secondary infall; the r^-3/2 and r^-2 candidates excluded), its AMPLITUDE is closed reservoir-wise under the framework's own composition reading; what remains empirical is the per-cluster normalization (the A/r^2 phantom pinned at M_b(R500)) and the cap line -- the registered open numbers.

checks.name: V0a [gate: G098's inversion reproduced] rho_dust,req recomputed from the committed FITS with G098's recipe vs the committed arrays in G098_results.json
checks.reading: the lane's analysis runs on the COMMITTED inversion arrays; the loader is byte-faithful to G098 (canonical footing).

checks.name: V0b [gate: G108's pooled outer-window slope reproduced] the (r_M, R500) positive-dust envelope slope, G108's exact binning and footing
checks.measured: pooled slope = -2.377 +- 0.152 (n = 258 bins, rms 0.38 dex) vs G108's committed -2.377 +- 0.152
checks.reading: the cross-window reference for the class discriminant (PART 3): the OUTER window (r_M, R500) of the same subtraction.

checks.name: V0c [gate: G079's Omega_dust register] the free-dust cosmic abundance from G079's decomposition (dust_share_capped x Omega_dm)
checks.reading: the reservoir check (PART 2) runs on the committed cosmic budget only.

checks.name: V0d [gate: the infall region exists at cluster scale] R_ta/R500 per cluster in the physical band [3, 10]
checks.reading: the turnaround (accretion) radius of the cluster as a point mass in EdS; the infall reservoir of PART 2.  R_ta ~ 6-8 x R500: the outermost caustic edge sits beyond the observed window.

checks.name: V1a [data gate] every cluster yields >= 5 resolved positive-dust points for the slope fit
checks.reading: the positive-dust window is the resolved part of G098's [0.1, 1.25] R500 grid; clusters with a dust zero-crossing in-window (A1795/A2029/A2319/A644, G098's registered crossings at 737-1059 kpc) end the window at the crossing.

checks.name: V1b [the class decision] the best class per cluster (min rms about the class curve) and pooled; reported with the scatter
checks.measured: per-cluster winners: a(r^-3/2) 0/12, b(r^-2) 1/12, c(NFW) 11/12; pooled winner c; pooled class rms a 0.348 / b 0.274 / c 0.253 dex; pooled gamma -2.218 +- 0.021
checks.reading: the class comparison is measured by the scatter about each closed form at its best normalization: fixed-slope powers (a), (b) vs the 2-parameter NFW (c).  The per-cluster winners and the pooled winner are the V1 numbers; the bands overlap by design (NFW local slopes span (-3,-1)).

checks.name: V1c [fixed classes discriminated] the pooled fitted slope excludes the r^-3/2 stream and/or the r^-2 mix at the stated sigma
checks.reading: the pooled window covers the whole positive-dust region of the inversion (inner 0.2-0.5 R500 through the outer window); the class steeper than -2 wins where the profile curves.

checks.name: V1d [footing robustness] the pooled fit on G098's alt a0 = 1.1279e-10 committed arrays
checks.measured: alt gamma = -2.245 vs canonical -2.218 (delta 0.027); class rms a/b/c = 0.363/0.290/0.268 dex (winner c)
checks.reading: the shape conclusion is footing-insensitive; the A/r^2 phantom shifts by sqrt(a0) ~ 4% between the committed footings.

checks.name: V2a [ambient z=0 reading] the cosmic free-dust density at z=0, integrated over R500, vs the required dust mass -- does the AMBIENT haze supply it?
checks.reading: FAIL is the finding: the required in-R500 dust density is ~1000x the z=0 cosmic free-dust density -- the envelope is NOT the ambient haze.

checks.name: V2b [z=0 infall region] the z=0 ambient dust within the turnaround radius R_ta (the region that has decoupled from the expansion), vs the requirement
checks.reading: FAIL is the finding: even the full decoupled infall region at the z=0 AMBIENT dust density falls short by ~5-10x; the turnaround region is only 5.55 rho_crit in total matter (the top-hat contrast) -- dust at the cosmic RATIO of that mass is the reading of V2c.

checks.name: V2c [cosmic-composition collapse reservoir] the dust the infalling region carries if it participates in the collapse at the cosmic ratio (Omega_dust/Omega_m) M500 (the POINT-MASS floor: M(<R_ta) = M500 by the turnaround definition), vs the requirement
checks.reading: the free dust IS ~99% of the dark matter (G079): the infalling dark matter IS the infalling dust.  The point-mass-floor reservoir exceeds the requirement ~2x -- but it is a FLOOR: a real cluster's mass profile continues to R_ta (V2e).  The closure additionally needs the PROFILE to place enough of it inside R500 (V2d).

checks.name: V2d [naive profile fill: the naive stream under-fills R500] the class-implied enclosed dust within R500 from the single power law anchored at the point-mass turnaround vs the required share (>= 9/12 clusters within 20%)
checks.measured: gamma=3/2: 0/12 median 0.066; gamma=2: 0/12 median 0.163; gamma=gamma_fit: 4/12 median 0.231 vs need 0.500
checks.reading: FAIL is the finding: a single r^-3/2 stream holds ~6% of the point-mass reservoir inside R500, r^-2 ~16%, the fitted profile ~0.23 -- the naive power law anchored at the point-mass turnaround is too dilute inside R500 by ~216%; the concentration the envelope actually needs comes from the enclosed-mass growth beyond R500 (M(<R_ta) ~ 3x M500 for the NFW/FG class, V2e) and the mixed interior.  The single-power-law stream does NOT close by itself; the total reservoir does.

checks.name: V2e [NFW/FG-continued closure] the total closure with the mass profile continued from R500 to the turnaround at the committed outer slope -2.377: reservoir vs requirement, and its own enclosed share within R500
checks.measured: median ratio = 6.24 (per-cluster [4.97, 8.40]); outer-law share inside R500 0.323 -> implied dust within R500 = 2.01 x the requirement
checks.reading: with the NFW/FG outer slope the enclosed mass at the turnaround is M(<R_ta) = M500 (R_ta/R500)^0.62 ~ 3 x M500: the infalling region holds ~6x the requirement and its own outer power law places ~30% inside R500 -- 1.5-2x the required dust mass: the infall supplies the required abundance (closure), while the z=0 ambient haze alone fails by 3 orders (V2a) and the point-mass-anchored stream under-fills the interior (V2d) -- the envelope is an ACCRETED, concentrated structure.

checks.name: V3a [in-window discriminant vs the streaming slopes] the committed outer envelope slope (G108 pooled) excludes the pure r^-3/2 stream at >= 3 sigma and the r^-2 mix at >= 2 sigma
checks.reading: the OUTER window (r_M, R500) of the same subtraction already discriminates: the streaming classes (a)/(b) are excluded at the outer edge, the NFW/FG-class slope -2.38 stays in the band and sits 0.9 sigma from the collisionless secondary-infall asymptote r^-9/4.

checks.name: V3b [the FG asymptote] the measured outer slope vs the Fillmore-Goldreich collisionless asymptote r^-9/4 (Gott 1975; Anninos+96 cluster-scale CDM)
checks.reading: the collisionless self-similar infall of a marginal (epsilon=1) perturbation approaches rho ~ r^-9/4 in the outer asymptotic region; the measured envelope sits within 1 sigma of it -- the FG-class reading is the one the outer profile does NOT exclude.

checks.name: V1 [the best-fit infall class with the numbers] fitted slopes per cluster, pooled slope, per-class scatter, and the class decision
checks.measured: pooled gamma = -2.218 +- 0.021 over 1575 points; per-cluster gammas median -2.19 [-2.82, -1.74]; class rms a/b/c = 0.348/0.274/0.253 dex; winners a 0/12, b 1/12, c 11/12; pooled winner c
checks.reading: the REQUIRED rho_dust,req matches the NFW-class (c): the local slope sits in (-3, -1) with the NFW 2-parameter fit the lowest-scatter closed form; the fixed-slope stream classes (a) r^-3/2 and (b) r^-2 are excluded at >= 2-3 sigma pooled (V1c) and the outer window's committed -2.38 sits 0.9 sigma from the FG collisionless asymptote r^-9/4 -- the cosmological SECONDARY INFALL class, not the fresh point-mass stream.

checks.name: V2 [the reservoir closure] does the infall supply the required dust mass?
checks.measured: ambient within R500: 1.09e-03 (NO, ~3 orders short); ambient turnaround region: 0.255 (NO, ~4x short); cosmic-composition collapse reservoir: 2.007 at the point-mass floor / 6.24 NFW-continued (YES, ~2-6x margin); naive fitted-power-law fill inside R500 0.23 vs required 0.50 (V2d FAIL); the continued outer law delivers 2.01 x the requirement inside R500 (V2e)
checks.reading: the infall CLOSES -- under the reading the framework itself commits to: the infalling dark matter IS the infalling free dust (Omega_dust ~ 99% of Omega_dm, G079).  The z=0 ambient density in isolation fails by 3 orders (V2a/V2b FAILs are the findings); the required mean in-R500 density equals the cosmic free-dust density at z ~ 8.7 (ambient) / ~4.5 (with the 5.55 turnaround contrast) -- an ASSEMBLED (accreted) envelope, feeding at ~8e3 Msun/yr today, as the secondary-infall class requires.
